summary: Iteration 15: verified 3 new features (Book/Game→Booking CTA, Game Leaderboard + My Simulations, Weekly Library Digest) + hCaptcha preview fix. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering anon/authed scoring, leaderboard shape, /me/simulations, admin library-digest run. Frontend: Book→Booking CTA prefills area/message and scrolls to #consult; Game result renders leaderboard + login prompt + discuss-sk; ClientDashboard shows dashboard-simulations with populated sim cards; hCaptcha TEST checkbox clicks to aria-checked=true on preview. Two issues found: (1) FIXED missing MessageSquare import in BookPage.jsx caused whole /library/:slug route to crash. (2) LibraryPage subscribe form does NOT send captcha_token — backend returns 400 'Captcha verification required'.

ui_bugs.issue: MessageSquare icon used but not imported → 'MessageSquare is not defined' runtime error, whole book page crashed
ui_bugs.priority: CRITICAL (fixed by testing agent — added MessageSquare to lucide-react import)

integration_issues.issue: subscribe() POSTs /api/newsletter with only {email} — no captcha_token. Backend verify_captcha rejects empty token with 400 'Captcha verification required' even on preview (empty-token short-circuit runs before preview-host check). Users can never subscribe from the Library page today. Fix: attach an hCaptcha widget (like consultation form) OR send captcha_token: 'preview' fallback; ideally reuse Captcha.jsx component.

action_items: LibraryPage subscribe must send a valid captcha_token — currently omits it, backend returns 400 on every submission (preview and prod). Suggest: add hCaptcha widget (reuse <Captcha/> component) or pass a preview-safe fallback token.

Consider hardening backend verify_captcha: allow empty token on preview host too (currently order: empty → 400 first, preview check second) — matches the newsletter form UX where captcha isn't mandatory.
Confirm the missing MessageSquare import fix is preserved and lint the BookPage.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 4972 lines — carry-over from iter 14; new game_scores/library-digest logic reinforces the case for router split (games, library, admin-digest).
score_game accepts any answers dict and silently scores 0 for unknown option ids; recommend Pydantic validator to 400 on unknown round/option ids so client bugs surface.
verify_captcha short-circuits on empty token BEFORE checking preview host — inconsistent with the stated 'lenient on preview' behaviour and directly caused the library-subscribe regression.
LibraryPage.jsx subscribe() lacks any captcha handling — every other form (login/register/consultation) uses <Captcha/>; adding it here keeps UX consistent and fixes the 400.
